screenshots.title: Runs
screenshots.purpose: See recent runs and which ones need attention, then open a run, its CI report, or its results.

screenshots.title: Benchmarks
screenshots.purpose: Find benchmarks by name, filter by machine, time window, and status, and see each one's latest change.

screenshots.title: Benchmark trend
screenshots.purpose: Follow one benchmark over time on each machine, with outliers, steps, and its results table.

screenshots.title: Result
screenshots.purpose: See one result's measurements and metadata, and where it sits in its benchmark's history.

screenshots.title: Results list
screenshots.purpose: List submitted results, filter by run or batch, and open a result or its trend.

screenshots.title: Run
screenshots.purpose: See one run's comparison with its baseline and open its results, batches, and trends.

screenshots.title: Batch
screenshots.purpose: See one batch_id across runs, with its CI reports, results, and trends.

screenshots.title: Compare
screenshots.purpose: Compare two results as a percent change and against the baseline's history.

screenshots.title: CI report
screenshots.purpose: Review a commit's CI verdict, its missing baselines, and the verdict for each benchmark.

screenshots.title: Account
screenshots.purpose: See who is signed in, and manage API tokens and alert rules.
